items.label: T1
items.content:
This utility will check the recruiting list for valid emails.  
If it finds a record with more than one valid email or none, it will pull up the record and give you a chance to edit it so that it will work with the Tawala Dirt Bowl utilities.
It is not possible to keep two email addresses in one contact field.
You will have the opportunity to edit or delete each record that fails the audit test.

items.label: H1
items.content: Team Rosters Management

items.label: T1
items.content:
You can manage your Team Rosters in three ways.  
1) You can export the registration forms to Excel, shuffle them as you like to make up teams, then add the team names to the Teams field in each Registration row (each player's information comes out in a single Excel row).
Then you can import the registration forms back into your Dirt Bowl project. 
It is very important that you  backup your data before you do this, as you could lose all of your registrations if you do it incorrectly.
You export, import and backup your records in your MyProjects Dirt Bowl Project Detail Page. The registration record file is called "Registration."  It is the first file you will see on the Project details page.
2) Instead of importing  your registration file back into Tawala, you can use the tools below to add the team assignment to each player.
3) Finally, you can try Tawala's new drag and drop capability (see list below) to assign players to different teams.
